note: Broomfield County created Nov 2001 from parts of Adams, Boulder, Jefferson and Weld (Census Bureau, Substantial Changes to Counties)
La Paz County created Jan 1983 from the northern part of Yuma County (Census Bureau, Substantial Changes to Counties)
Cibola County created June 1981 from the western part of Valencia County (Census Bureau, Substantial Changes to Counties); Valencia fell from 61,115 (1980) to 45,235 (1990)
Los Alamos County created 1949 from parts of Sandoval and Santa Fe counties (first in NHGIS in 1950)
Menominee County created 1961 from parts of Shawano and Oconto counties (first in NHGIS in 1970)
